_finding: A ticker resolves against the trusted and the held exact matches together (docs/simulate-buy-tz.md §4.1, outside review of #266): a held record reached by its bare ticker or ISIN goes to the verdict and gets its 503, and one that shares the words with a trusted record makes the ticker ambiguous, never a quote for the trusted one.

mutations.name: held exact matches are dropped
mutations.find: let held = Array.isArray(found?.held) ? found.held.filter((h) => h && h.chain === chain && h.match_quality === 'exact') : []
mutations.expect: FAIL a held record reached by an alias
